title: tooling(qa): check-platform-checklist has no legal shape for a planned item retired before it was implemented — statusFieldProblems judges `retired` by the active rule (`since` must be a release, `steps` non-empty)
body:
Unblocks: #22869 — PR #22982 (the retire of `records-forms.picklist-org-append`) would add 2 validator problems on main until this lands. This card carries the checker fix; the parent keeps the retire and its three ledger files.

Derived from the in-flight card #22869 by the skills seat (`session_01CinRQcE6T8SvMbhH8D3NhS`), from the dev's class-a finding measured at PR #22982 head `57ef232b7`; parent domain and priority inherited (the one bypass of triage, for a sub-issue a claimed card needs to land). Cross-lane: `scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` is the devx lane's file by path; the seat declares the touch on the devx seat post.

## Reading

- `scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs#statusFieldProblems` (line ~172 on `origin/main` `246edf5b3`): one branch for `status === 'planned'`; every other status, `retired` included, falls through to the active rule — `"since" must be the release that introduced the capability` and `"steps" must be a non-empty array of strings`.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md`, Lifecycle → Retire: set `status: "retired"` + `retiredReason` (and `supersededBy` when a successor exists); the row stays. It asks for no `since` and no `steps`.
- The only two retired items before PR #22982 (`dashboards.saved-report-ownership`, `dashboards.report-schedule-dispatch-delivery`) were active before retiring (`since: "v15.1"`, steps present), so this path was never exercised.
- Measured on PR #22982: base `117817ec2` reads `check-platform-checklist: 8 problem(s)` (symbol anchors in `access-security`, `attachments-storage`, `search` — the open main-red anchor #22924's); head `57ef232b7` reads 10; the diff of the two lists is exactly the 2 lines above, both on `records-forms.picklist-org-append`. Minimal repro: flip any planned item to `retired` with a `retiredReason`.
- Public door: `pnpm check:platform-checklist`, run on main by `platform-checklist-watchdog.yml`; by maintainer decision it is not per-PR CI (`.github/workflows/lint.yml:3102–3110`).

## Change

1. `statusFieldProblems`: a `retired` branch that judges by the README's Retire rule — `retiredReason` is a non-empty string; `since` is `null` (never shipped) or a release-shaped string; `steps` may be absent or empty (a never-implemented capability has nothing to drive). A retired item that was active keeps whatever it had and still passes. ⛔ No new required field beyond what the README names; ⛔ no change to the `planned` or active rules.
2. `--self-test`: a retired item with `since: null` and no `steps` passes; a retired item without `retiredReason` fails; a retired item with a non-release `since` string fails; the existing active and planned cases unchanged. The script's own mutation battery (its header describes the shadowing checks on `statusFieldProblems`) must still red when the new branch is dropped.
3. Verify the unblock: with PR #22982's `records-forms.json` applied in the worktree (uncommitted, restored after), `pnpm check:platform-checklist` reads 8 problems, not 10; report both counts and the restore proof.
4. Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` from the worktree; a `scripts/` script edit owes the script's own tests beyond the derived families (`git grep -l check-platform-checklist -- 'scripts/**/*.test.*' scripts/__tests__` for siblings). `skip-changeset` (`scripts/` is not published).

⛔ No ledger data invented; ⛔ no `docs/qa/**` edit here (the parent's PR owns them); ⛔ `dispatch-gates*.mjs` stay frozen.

## Who acts

The skills seat dispatches it as the blocked seat (the unowned-blocker channel) and, the path not being governed, lands it through the queue after its own at-tier review. PR #22982 lands after this PR.

## Dedup

MCP issue search over objectstack-ai/objectstack, open and closed, query "check-platform-checklist retired item since steps statusFieldProblems retire planned item validator": 28 hits. Nearest: #22924 (open: the watchdog's main-red anchor for the 8 symbol-anchor problems — a different failure, which this card does not touch), #19157 (closed: introduced `status: planned`, the origin of the one-branch shape), #22487 (closed: retired a step and a clause of an active item), #22557 (closed, not planned: an anchor red). None gives `retired` its own rule.

Refs: #22869 · PR #22982 · #22924.
